summary.text: Janeese Lewis George has been the Ward 4 Councilmember on the Council of the District of Columbia since being elected in 2020.

paragraphs.text: She is a native of Ward 4 and a graduate of DC Public Schools, including School Without Walls.
She earned a B.A. in Government and Politics from St. John's University and a J.D. from Howard University School of Law.
She began her legal career in 2014 in Philadelphia's district attorney's office and later worked as an Assistant Attorney General in the Juvenile Section of the DC Office of the Attorney General.
